about: Draft X posts for Kaskade's Evolution log. When you add an Evolution entry, append one post to the end of this list in the same pull request. Give it a new id (the date plus a short slug), the date, the link it points to, who drafted it, and text under 250 characters. State plain facts the entry supports, with no hashtags. Never edit or remove a post that is already here. When Graham merges, a GitHub Action opens an issue with a one-tap Post on X link. Nothing posts automatically.

posts.text: Kaskade's Evolution log now drafts its own status posts. When a new entry merges, the repo writes one up for review, and nothing goes out until a person presses Post. This is the first one.

Kaskade’s AI crew moved into its own repo this week. GPT and Claude checked each other’s work and caught a name conflict and a wrong contact address. The models did the sifting; a person knew what gold looks like. Free pilots are open.
